BinarySelector.description: selects which files to upload to a host, based on host role and install method.

arch.description: lists the CPU architectures this file applies to. An empty list means every architecture the package targets.

package.description: selects which install method receives this file: rpm, apt, or binary.

profile.description: selects which host role receives this file: worker or controller.

roles.description: lists the host roles this file applies to.

FileSource.description: records where one file in the package was actually read from, for a file whose declared source a --file-override redirected.

declared.description: is the source the distro definition named.

override.description:
is the Source prefix of the override that matched, which is the one that won
when several could have.

path.description:
is where the file was staged inside the package, for example "files/0/k3s". It
identifies the entry even when several files share a declared source.

resolved.description:
is where cargoship read the bytes from instead: a mirror URL, or a path on
the build host.

shasum.description:
is the checksum the bytes were verified against. An override is refused for a
file that declares none, so this is never empty.

darwin.description: (default 'sh') Indicates a preference for the shell to use on macOS systems

linux.description: (default 'sh') Indicates a preference for the shell to use on Linux systems

windows.description: (default 'powershell') Indicates a preference for the shell to use on Windows systems (note that choosing 'cmd' will turn off migrations like touch -> New-Item)

ZarfDistroActions.description: defines the actions cargoship runs during specific phases of building the distro package.

onCreate.description: lists the actions cargoship runs when it creates the package.

ZarfDistroBuildData.description: holds information recorded when the package was built.

architecture.description: is the CPU architecture used to build the package. Populated only when the package targets a single architecture.

architectures.description: lists the CPU architectures used to build the package.

fileOverrides.description:
maps each source URL prefix to the mirror or local directory files were
downloaded from instead. Like RegistryOverrides, this is the configuration the build was
given. For what each override actually did, see FileSources.

fileSources.description:
records every file whose source an override redirected: what the definition
declared, where the bytes were read from instead, and the checksum they were verified
against. It is empty for a build that used no overrides, so a package built without them
is unchanged. Entries are in the order the files were staged, which is the order they
appear in the definition, so a reproducible build still produces identical output.

provenanceFiles.description:
lists files in the package that checksums.txt does not cover.
These are files added after cargoship generates checksums, for example signature files.
The signed distro.yaml authenticates this list.

registryOverrides.description: maps each original registry to the registry actually used to build the package.

reproducible.description:
indicates Build.Timestamp was pinned to a fixed value
(config.Timestamp) instead of the actual build time, so identical
package inputs produce byte-identical output.

signed.description: indicates whether the package was signed. A nil value means the signing status was not recorded.

timestamp.description: is the time the package was created.

version.description: records the distro version used to build the package.

ZarfDistroConfig.description: holds the configuration for the distro engine.

engine.description: holds configuration passed through to the distro engine.

manifest.description: maps a chart name to the Helm values cargoship writes to that chart's HelmChartConfig. A value is either a YAML string or a mapping.

files.description: lists files that cargoship writes to every host, no matter which install method it uses.

imageConfig.description: holds settings for the images bundled with the package.

manifests.description:
lists on-host paths -- each one the Target of a Files entry -- that cargoship
kubectl-applies, in order, from the leader once it bootstraps. Delivery is already solved by
Files; this is only the marker that says "and apply this one," e.g. for a CNI a package
declares. A distro with no apply mechanism (rke2/k3s use HelmChartConfig instead) ignores it.

os.description: holds settings applied to the host operating system.

ZarfDistroImageConfig.description: holds settings for the images cargoship writes to a host.

compression.description: sets the compression format for the image tarballs.

images.description: lists the offline images required by the package.

path.description: is the upload destination for the image tarballs.

ZarfDistroMetadata.description: holds identifying information for a distro package.

aggregateChecksum.description: is the checksum of the checksums.txt file, which lists the checksum for every layer in the package.

annotations.description: holds key-value pairs added to the OCI manifest.

architecture.description: is the CPU architecture this distro package targets. Use Architectures to target more than one.

architectures.description: lists the CPU architectures this distro package targets. It supersedes Architecture, which stays valid for a package targeting a single architecture.

athors.description: sets the OCI annotation for the contact details of the people or organization responsible for the image.

description.description: explains what this distro package does.

documentation.description: sets the OCI annotation for the URL to the image documentation.

source.description: sets the OCI annotation for the URL to the image source code.

uncompressed.description: disables compression for this package when true.

url.description: sets the OCI annotation for more information about the image.

vendor.description: sets the OCI annotation for the name of the organization or individual that distributes the image.

version.description: is the distro version cargoship installs. We recommend matching it to the Kubernetes version you install.

ZarfDistroOS.description: holds settings applied to a host.

env.description: maps environment variables cargoship sets on the host.

fapolicyd.description: holds the fapolicyd config file contents cargoship writes to a host.

files.description: lists files cargoship uploads to a host.

kernel.description: lists the kernel modules cargoship enables on the host.

sysctl.description: maps sysctl keys to the values cargoship applies to a host.

ZarfDistroSpec.description: holds the configuration for a distro package.

actions.description: defines the actions cargoship runs while building the package.

type.description: selects the distro engine: rke2, k3s, or upstream.

values.description: holds the default values the package is built with, and the schema they must satisfy.

version.description: is the version of the distro engine.

ZarfDistroValueMapping.description: projects one value onto one place in the engine configuration.

source.description: is the dotted path to read from the resolved values, e.g. .cilium.encryption.enabled

target.description:
is the dotted path to write, relative to spec.config.engine,
e.g. .manifest.rke2-cilium.encryption.enabled

ZarfDistroValues.description: declares the values a package ships with.

files.description: lists the YAML values files cargoship merges, in order, to build the package's default values. Each entry is a path relative to the package definition, an absolute path, or a URL. A later file overrides an earlier one, key by key.

mappings.description:
project values onto the engine configuration, so that one value a
cluster sets reaches wherever the distro needs it. Each mapping reads the
source path out of the resolved values and writes it to the target path,
which is relative to spec.config.engine. A source the values do not define
is left alone, so the package's own engine configuration stands as the
default.

schema.description: is the JSON Schema document the merged values must satisfy. Cargoship checks the values against it when it builds the package, and refuses to build when they do not match. The schema must not use $ref.

ZarfFile.description: defines a file shared by the distro and cluster APIs.

executable.description: sets executable permissions on the file when true.

extractPath.description: is the path cargoship extracts from a tarball.

group.description: is the group that owns the file.

isDirectory.description: indicates that Target is a directory. Cargoship uses this mainly for image uploads.

name.description: identifies the file entry. It is not the file name on disk.

perm.description: sets the permissions cargoship applies to the file. It accepts an octal string or an integer, for example "0644" or 644.

selector.description: controls whether cargoship uploads this file to a given node.

shasum.description: verifies the file when cargoship sources the distro package.

source.description: is the path where cargoship finds the file when it creates the package.

symlinks.description: lists the symlinks cargoship creates that point to Target.

target.description: is the path on the remote host where cargoship writes the file.

template.description: renders the file's contents as a Go template against the package's values before cargoship uploads it. It defaults to false, because most files are binaries or archives that a template pass would corrupt.

user.description: is the user that owns the file.

ZarfFiles.description: is an ordered list of files.

description: is the root object of a distro package configuration document.

apiVersion.description: identifies the API group and version of this configuration document.

build.description: holds information recorded when the package was built.

kind.description: identifies the document type. The value must be ZarfDistro.

metadata.description: holds identifying information for the distro package.

spec.description: holds the configuration for the distro package.
